24.en:
Situation Report — Day 27

  • ACTIVE: US/Israeli airstrikes on Iran continue. Iran, Hezbollah and allied units continue missile/rocket strikes into Israel. Northern border active daily.

Diplomacy & Pauses

  • US (Trump) announced 2nd pause on Iran-targeted energy strikes: 10 days, deadline Apr 6 2026 8:00 PM ET.
  • US claims talks progressing; Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan is mediating.
  • Earlier short pause was violated by strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr — risk of repeat violations remains high.

Military & Frontlines

  • IDF/US continue strikes inside Iran; Israeli forces report destruction of underground Hezbollah facility.
  • IDF demolished a 200m terror tunnel in southern Lebanon.
  • IDF troops in southern Syria were fired on and conducted a helicopter strike in response.
  • Northern border: daily Hezbollah activity and exchanges.

Strait of Hormuz

  • Iran allows passage for select states (Russia, India, China) and blocks others.
  • Reports say US and Iran agreed to halt attacks on Hormuz and plan talks in Qatar on Tuesday.

Cyber, Economy & Airspace

  • Israeli cyberattacks from Iran surged in 2026, per Israeli cyber chief.
  • Oil prices up; markets choppy on halt/strike uncertainty.
  • Airspace disruption: major airports in Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon and Jordan reported closed.

🟢 Good News

  • 10-day pause announced gives a temporary reduction window for energy strikes and creates a venue for talks.
  • IDF removed a long cross-border tunnel, lowering an immediate infiltration threat.
  • Israel dispatched a rescue delegation to Venezuela after the quake.
Threat assessment: escalating

Active strikes/sirens:

  • US and Iran reportedly agreed to halt attacks on Hormuz and plan talks in Qatar (Pakistan mediating).

  • Pakistan actively mediating. Qatar to host Hormuz talks.

Cyber & ISR

  • Israeli cyber chief: Iranian cyberattacks surged in 2026. Ongoing cyber activity targets Israeli networks.

Regional operations & closures

  • IDF forces in southern Syria were fired upon; Israeli helicopter strike retaliated.
  • Airspace disruptions: major airports in Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan reported closed or limited.

International moves

  • Iran’s selective reopening of Hormuz to friendly navies (Russia/India/China) shifts commercial-risk patterns.

🟢 Good News

  • New 10-day pause announced and talks scheduled. IDF successfully destroyed a cross-border tunnel. Humanitarian/rescue deployments continuing (Israeli team to Venezuela).
Threat assessment: Escalating
